description: Indahl Spend Cap: refuses tool calls once the session has used the budget in .claude/spend-cap.json. Does nothing without a budget file. Runs python3, or python where python3 is the Windows Store stub.

hooks.command: P=python3; $P -c 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || P=python; $P -c 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "spend-cap: no working Python (python3 or python) was found, so the budget cannot be checked. Tool calls are refused until a working Python is on PATH or the plugin is disabled." >&2; exit 2; }; exec $P "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/spend_cap.py"
